# Presentify extractor verification (v3.12.0 Phase 6, resolves MT-1).
#
# The workflow itself starts on every protected-branch PR because `verify` is a
# required status check. A lightweight detector keeps the expensive extractor
# dependencies and suites path-scoped. Event-level `paths` filters cannot be
# used for a required check: GitHub leaves the absent context pending forever
# on unrelated PRs, which makes the protected branch impossible to merge.

name: Presentify extractor

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

# v3.15.8 Phase 9.3: least privilege. This workflow builds and tests only --
# no gh CLI, comments or pushes; retained reports need no extra permission -- so read-only
# contents is the complete requirement.
permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PIP_CONSTRAINT: ${{ github.workspace }}/scripts/ci/requirements-py311.txt

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  detect:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      presentify: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.presentify }}
    steps:
      - if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
        id: paths
        name: Detect Presentify changes
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # A history-rewrite validation has no PR base; exercise the full check.
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == 'workflow_dispatch' ]]; then
            echo "presentify=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          base="$PR_BASE_SHA"
          head="$PR_HEAD_SHA"

          if [[ "$base" =~ ^0+$ ]] || ! git cat-file -e "$base^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            base="$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 "$head" | tail -n 1)"
          fi

          changed_files="$(git diff --name-only "$base" "$head")"
          if grep -Eq '^(catalog/skills/specialized-domains/document-to-interactive-html/|catalog/commands/presentify\.md$|tests/skills/|tests/fixtures/presentify/|docs/archives/v3/v3\.12/development/fixtures/(gen_fixtures|verify_phase1|enrich_models|verify_design_seed)\.py$|docs/archives/v3/v3\.13/development/fixtures/(verify_universal_ingestion|verify_imagery)\.py$|scripts/ci/|\.github/workflows/presentify-extractor\.yml$)' <<< "$changed_files"; then
            echo "presentify=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "presentify=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  extractor-tests:
    # This job must exist on every protected PR because branch protection
    # requires its `verify` context. Its expensive steps remain path-scoped.
    needs: detect
    # `always()` keeps this required context resolvable even when detection
    # fails. The first step then fails closed instead of leaving the job skipped.
    if: always() && (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Require successful path detection
        if: needs.detect.result != 'success'
        run: |
          echo "Presentify path detection ended with: ${{ needs.detect.result }}" >&2
          exit 1

      - if: needs.detect.result == 'success' && needs.detect.outputs.presentify == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - if: needs.detect.result == 'success' && needs.detect.outputs.presentify == 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'
          cache-dependency-path: |
            .github/workflows/presentify-extractor.yml
            scripts/ci/requirements-py311.txt

      - name: Install extractor + fixture dependencies
        if: needs.detect.result == 'success' && needs.detect.outputs.presentify == 'true'
        run: >
          pip install python-pptx python-docx openpyxl pdfplumber pypdf
          pypdfium2 Pillow reportlab rapidocr-onnxruntime ruff==0.16.1 pytest

      - name: Repository-native presentify-verify profile
        if: needs.detect.result == 'success' && needs.detect.outputs.presentify == 'true'
        run: python scripts/ci/run.py --profile full --only presentify-verify --reports-dir reports

      - name: Publish native profile summary
        if: always() && needs.detect.result == 'success' && needs.detect.outputs.presentify == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: cat reports/summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" || true

      - name: Retain native profile reports
        if: always() && needs.detect.result == 'success' && needs.detect.outputs.presentify == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: presentify-verify-reports
          path: reports/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  render:
    # Deterministic rendered checks gate the same merge result as extraction.
    needs: detect
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.detect.outputs.presentify == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'
          cache-dependency-path: |
            .github/workflows/presentify-extractor.yml
            scripts/ci/requirements-py311.txt

      - name: Install the render + extractor dependencies
        run: >
          pip install playwright python-pptx python-docx openpyxl pdfplumber
          pypdf pypdfium2 Pillow reportlab pytest PyYAML

      # The browser download is ~130MB and changes only when Playwright's pinned
      # revision does, so it is keyed on the resolved playwright version rather
      # than on the workflow file.
      - name: Resolve the Playwright version for the cache key
        id: pw
        run: echo "version=$(python -c 'import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version("playwright"))')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Cache the Playwright browser download
        uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ms-playwright-chromium-${{ runner.os }}-${{ steps.pw.outputs.version }}

      - name: Install chromium
        run: python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Repository-native presentify-render profile
        run: python scripts/ci/run.py --profile full --only presentify-render --reports-dir reports

      - name: Publish native profile summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: cat reports/summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" || true

      - name: Retain native profile reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: presentify-render-reports
          path: reports/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  verify:
    needs: [detect, extractor-tests, render]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Require detection and every selected native profile
        env:
          R_detect: ${{ needs.detect.result }}
          R_selected: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.presentify }}
          R_extract: ${{ needs['extractor-tests'].result }}
          R_render: ${{ needs.render.result }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$R_detect" = success
          case "$R_selected" in
            true) test "$R_extract" = success; test "$R_render" = success ;;
            false) for result in "$R_extract" "$R_render"; do
              case "$result" in success|skipped) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
            done ;;
            *) exit 1 ;;
          esac
